item.title: Union Cong Discusses: The Sum of Us (Guild Room) — Tue Sep 29, 7:00 PM — Guild Room
item.description: The Racial Justice Ministry Team is sponsoring a 2-session book discussion of The Sum of Us: What Racism Costs Everyone and How We Can Prosper Together by Heather McGhee, in advance of the townwide Open Book/Open Mind program: Heather McGhee in conversation with Michelle Alexander (free with registration) on October 13. The book traces the history of how some communities, faced with integration, chose instead to defund, eliminate, and ultimately privatize public goods such as public swimming pools. But there is a better, more hope-filled way: to grow the pie to benefit everyone and collect the Solidarity Dividend. Join Union members and friends for pizza and discussion of key book topics (summary sheets available for download in advance) and personal reflection on September 29 and October 6 from 7 pm – 8:30 pm in the Main Building. Discussion topics will be different each week, so please plan to attend one or both sessions! Please RSVP here so we can be sure to have enough pizza.

item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Saturdays) — Sat Oct 10, 9:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Join us for friendly and sociable free rallies and possibly some informal matches for training and fun. We are beginner to intermediate levels but all are welcome. We don’t allow formal instruction on our group-reserved courts, although giving some quick tips is OK so long as you’re not holding up others waiting to play.
⛑️ **Clinic Matches:** If we have to rotate people in then we may play some clinic-style matches where everyone rotates in evenly. There is no holding the court via wins so everyone has a chance to play regardless of skill level.
🕊️ **Early Bird Start:** If you want to meet earlier than 9 AM (like 8 or 8:30) then please let us know by the day before and we’ll see who can join you (usually I can do earlier).
**🎾 Equipment:** Please bring your own racquet and water, as we don’t provide those. I always have some balls for at least one court, but feel free to bring your own in case we need to branch out over more than one

item.title: New Jersey Symphony: Handel’s Messiah — Sat Dec 19, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Run Time: 2 hours and 15 minutes New Jersey Symphony’s glorious holiday tradition returns with this iconic masterpiece, a classical rendition of the greatest story ever told, composed by George Frideric Handel and featuring the University Singers. The majestic music—including the triumphant “Hallelujah Chorus”—rekindles the spirit of the holidays for first-time listeners and those who return each season. This event features conductor Kendrick Armstrong, soprano Jessica Rivera, mezzo-soprano Kelley O’Connor, tenor Martin Bakari, and bass-baritone Kevin Short. The University Singers are directed by Heather J. Buchanan.
Source: PEAK Performances at MSU
